top_signals.title: Next Lifts Outlook as Demand Bucks Downbeat Consumer Outlook
top_signals.summary: Next Plc raised its outlook for the third time this fiscal year, after sales surged more than the company expected in the second quarter due to warm UK weather and pent-up demand in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Fairshake backed Michigan's Bill Huizenga and Washington's Suzan DelBene, Kim Schrier, Marilyn Strickland and Amanda McKinney.

top_signals.title: Next hikes targets as heatwave boosts sales
top_signals.summary: Next has upgraded its profit targets for the year after breezing past second quarter expectations, putting its shareholders in line for a bumper payday.
